versions.changelog: Rewrote frontmatter description to concise 200–500 character format for improved agent-trigger clarity.

Initial release. Three-phase Comprehensive Medication Review workflow covering structured intake (patient, conditions, medications, labs, adherence), drug-therapy problem identification with Beers and STOPP/START screening, renal- and hepatic-dose review, deprescribing taper plans, and a prescriber-ready DRAFT Medication Action Plan, Personal Medication List, and prescriber communication letter — DRAFT-only, for licensed-pharmacist review.
